headline: Vickyfym climbs from 1599th to 77th on ARC-3

sections.text: Vickyfym gained 8.17 points to reach 33.94, rising from 1599th to 77th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb moves Vickyfym from outside the top 500 into the top 100.
